coverageNote.tests: whether the tool call targeted the wrong object, detectable from the arguments and the rest of the run's evidence
coverageNote.namedModeRequires: recognizing a malformed argument (wrong type, missing field) to the right tool and the right target — a different failure shape than wrong-target
coverageNote.closedBy: toolArgumentsCorrect in its named sense (PRD Appendix A, deferred to Phase 2)
coverageNote.acceptedForMvp: a wrong-target call is detectable today via toolWasAppropriate's wrong-target option; a malformed-but-correctly-targeted argument is not
